entities.name: Jiří Kejval
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jiří Kejval is a Czech sports official, businessman and since 2012 President of the Czech Olympic Committee. During his active sports career he competed at international level and for eighteen years was President of the Czech Rowing Association.
